---
pagetitle: "EL context"
params:
  pkg_path: ""
  spec_file: "00_SIM_EL_Spec"
  bundle_file: ""
  state_name: ""
  instrument_label: ""
  source_note: ""
  partner_logo: ""
  pooled_years: 5
  population: "tested"
  share_breaks: "0, 0.05, 0.20, 0.40"
  size_breaks: "0, 1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000"
  districts: ""
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: [default, deck.scss]
    width: 1600
    height: 900
    margin: 0.04
    center: false
    slide-number: c
    logo: assets/nciea_logo.png
    footer: '<img src="assets/cc_by.png" class="footer-cc" alt="CC BY"> www.nciea.org'
    embed-resources: true
    transition: none
    controls: false
    progress: false
    menu: false
    hash-type: number
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
fig-dpi: 150
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
# A state EL context deck built on stateELP. Every number comes from
# run_prep2_context() on an el_data bundle; this file holds the layout, the
# authored wording around the numbers, and one call per figure. Render with
# rs_deck() in dev/render_step.R (it renders outside Dropbox and scans the
# output for student ids). With no `bundle_file` the deck runs on the shipped
# simulation and says so on every slide. A state's own settings -- name,
# source note, districts to profile -- are passed as params, typically from a
# YAML file kept outside the repository (rs_deck(params_file = ...)).
if (nzchar(params$pkg_path) && dir.exists(file.path(params$pkg_path, "R"))) {
  devtools::load_all(params$pkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
} else {
  library(stateELP)
}
if (!exists("%||%")) `%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x  # base R < 4.4

spec <- read_el_spec(params$spec_file)
bundle <- if (nzchar(params$bundle_file)) {
  readRDS(params$bundle_file)
} else {
  as_el_data(el_long_sim, roster = el_roster_sim, spec = spec)
}
stopifnot(inherits(bundle, "el_data"))

# Districts to profile: a list of {id, label, setting, notes}, passed by
# rs_deck() from a params file. Empty lets the data pick four settings
# (largest, highest share, median, smallest). knitr will not take a list as a
# header default, hence "" there and the breaks as comma-separated text.
# Quarto's parameter round-trip can hand a list of entries back as a data
# frame (one column per field, `notes` a nested data frame), so both shapes
# become one list of entries here.
as_entries <- function(x) {
  if (is.data.frame(x)) {
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(x)), function(i) lapply(x, function(col) {
      if (is.data.frame(col)) as.list(col[i, , drop = FALSE]) else col[[i]]
    }))
  } else if (is.list(x)) x else list()
}
dl <- as_entries(params$districts)
entry_notes <- function(e) {
  n <- unlist(e$notes)
  n[!is.na(n) & nzchar(n)]
}
num <- function(x) as.numeric(trimws(strsplit(as.character(x), ",")[[1]]))
ids <- NULL
if (length(dl)) {
  ids <- vapply(dl, function(z) as.character(z$id %||% ""), "")
  if (!all(nzchar(ids))) {
    stop("Every entry under `districts` needs its DISTRICT_ID in `id`.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  names(ids) <- vapply(dl, function(z) {
    s <- as.character(z$setting %||% "")
    if (is.na(s)) "" else s
  }, "")
}

res <- run_prep2_context(
  bundle, spec,
  pooled_years = params$pooled_years,
  population   = params$population,
  share_breaks = num(params$share_breaks),
  size_breaks  = num(params$size_breaks),
  districts    = ids)

is_sim <- !is.null(res$meta$sim_contract_version) &&
  !is.na(res$meta$sim_contract_version)
state <- if (nzchar(params$state_name)) {
  params$state_name
} else if (is_sim) "the simulated state" else spec$program$state
state_students <- if (is_sim && !nzchar(params$state_name)) "the simulated state's" else state
state_cap <- paste0(toupper(substr(state, 1, 1)), substring(state, 2))
instrument <- if (nzchar(params$instrument_label)) {
  params$instrument_label
} else spec$elp$instrument
notes <- prep2_context_notes(res, state = state_students)

sy <- function(y) paste0(y - 1L, "–", sprintf("%02d", as.integer(y) %% 100L))
years_label <- function(a, b) if (a == b) sy(a) else paste(sy(a), "to", sy(b))

# The source line on every content slide. Simulated data says so in words.
src <- function(years, extra = NULL) {
  who <- if (is_sim) {
    sprintf("simulated data, not a real state (stateELP sim v%s)",
            res$meta$sim_contract_version)
  } else if (nzchar(params$source_note)) {
    params$source_note
  } else {
    paste(spec$program$department %||% state, "student-level data")
  }
  paste0("Source: ", who, ", ", years, ".", if (length(extra)) paste0(" ", extra) else "")
}
absent <- function(what) {
  sprintf('<p class="absent">%s is not available for this delivery.</p>', what)
}
esc <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
md_bold <- function(x) gsub("\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*", "<strong>\\1</strong>", esc(x), perl = TRUE)

eg <- res$exit_by_grade
ey <- res$exit_by_years
latest <- res$meta$latest_year
```

## `r state_cap`: English Learner Context {.deck-title}

`r if (is_sim) '<div class="sim-banner">Simulated data: every number on these slides describes the stateELP simulation, not a real state.</div>' else ""`

::: {.sample}
**Sample.** `r res$meta$sample`
:::

::: {.made-with}
Computed by stateELP `r res$meta$package_version` (`run_prep2_context()`) under the `r res$meta$spec_id` spec, `r format(res$meta$run_date, "%B %d, %Y")`. Cells under `r res$meta$min_cell` students are suppressed.
:::

## `r instrument` Exit Rates by Grade

```{r exit-grade}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| out-width: 100%
#| results: asis
if (is.null(eg)) cat(absent("An exit rate by grade")) else print(plot_context_exit_rates(eg))
```

::: {.callout-box}
`r notes$exit_grade %||% "Too few grades have a reportable exit rate to compare."`
:::

::: {.source}
`r if (is.null(eg)) "" else src(years_label(attr(eg, "pooled")[1], attr(eg, "pooled")[2]), "Exited = a former EL the next year. Who exits, not how long it takes.")`
:::

```{r exit-years}

  print(plot_context_exit_rates(ey, series = "latest"))
```

::: {.callout-box}
**Instead:** identify groups, settings, and scenarios that are common in `r state`, and look at each one, in addition to the state as a whole.
:::

```{r profiles}
#| results: asis
prof <- res$profiles
if (is.null(prof)) {
  cat("\n\n## District Profiles\n\n", absent("A district profile"), "\n")
} else {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(prof$summary))) {
    id <- prof$summary$DISTRICT_ID[[i]]
    entry <- if (length(dl)) dl[[match(id, ids)]] else list()
    lab <- entry$label %||% id
    if (is.na(lab) || !nzchar(lab)) lab <- id
    t <- prep2_profile_text(prof, id, label = lab,
                            state = if (is_sim && !nzchar(params$state_name)) "statewide" else state,
                            population = res$meta$population)
    rows <- c(t$rows, entry_notes(entry))
    cat("\n\n## ", esc(t$title), " {.profile}\n\n", sep = "")
    cat('<div class="cards">\n')
    for (cd in t$cards) {
      cat(sprintf('<div class="card"><div class="big">%s</div><div class="small">%s</div></div>\n',
                  esc(cd$big), esc(cd$small)))
    }
    cat('</div>\n<table class="detail">\n')
    for (k in names(rows)) {
      cat(sprintf('<tr><td class="label">%s</td><td>%s</td></tr>\n', esc(k), md_bold(rows[[k]])))
    }
    cat('</table>\n')
    cat(sprintf('<div class="source">%s</div>\n',
                esc(src(sy(prof$summary$YEAR[[i]]),
                        "Former ELs are those within the monitoring window; school shares are shown only where a school's EL count is reportable."))))
    if (nzchar(params$partner_logo)) {
      cat(sprintf('<img class="partner-logo" src="%s" alt="">\n', params$partner_logo))
    }
  }
}
```
